analysis: Documentation-only changes. In docs/architecture/hardware-support.md, the date line changes (head line 3), and a new section, 'Gemma 4 tensor-parallel rank memory' (head lines 1125-1154), describes Gemma4TensorParallelRequestBudget per-rank charges. These cover the weights cut, its own KV heads, chunk transients, FP32 partials, prefix capture, the 5.5 GiB activation floor, the freed-buffer cache and the sealed collective frames. It states that the prompt-prefix memory tier is budgeted as half of the measured room and is charged nowhere. It also states that nothing is measured on a pair. Lines 1146-1151 reference QwenStagePrefixCache.budget for the in-memory cluster prefix tier. This RAM-only cluster prefix cache is a different component from the T-041 SSD tier. No at-rest artifact, cache-salt scoping or TTL change is described, so T-041 and SEC-035 are not visibly affected. The claim that collective frames are sealed (line 1139) is consistent with the existing encrypted cluster collective design. The docs/architecture/inference.md unit came as metadata only. Its patch excerpt shows a Gemma ClusterTensorParallelChoice.fastest placement exemption (head 3635-3638), a renamed TensorParallelSwitchLinear reference and a new Gemma 4 TP foundation section (head 4037-4240). That section's text was not supplied, which is a coverage limit. No security regression is identified: these are memory-accounting and placement documentation changes with no auth, attestation, encryption or wire changes visible. The next pass should check whether the inference.md Gemma TP section introduces cluster prefix-cache sharing or a new collective crypto. It should also check whether that section introduces a cross-Mac data path needing a threat-model update under TB-007, T-041 or T-028.
